title: AI Job Matching Agent
description: An LLM-powered job matching agent that analyzes candidate profiles and job descriptions to produce ranked match scores with reasoning.
challenge: Manual resume screening was bottlenecking the hiring pipeline. Recruiters spent hours reading resumes for positions that could be filtered programmatically.
solution: Built an agent that parses both job descriptions and candidate profiles into structured embeddings, then uses a combination of semantic similarity and LLM reasoning to produce scored, ranked candidate lists with human-readable explanations.
